winner_reason: The Odyssey delivered the strongest entertainment headline of the day, opening to $264.1 million worldwide and $124.5 million domestically while drawing a sizable 18-to-34 audience for a nearly 3,000-year-old story.
loser_reason: Thalapathy Vijay’s farewell film had the weakest major news day after reports of a significant Day 2 box office drop following a strong opening.
